REVOLUTION D.F. is a full modular 80 PLUS® Gold certified PSU series with the patented DFR™ (Dust Free Rotation) technology, preventing dust accumul ation and granting a cleaner and long lasting PSU. The D.F. Switch design offers an on button activation of the DFR™ mode at any time. The choice to use only 100% Japanese 105°C electrolytic capacitors ensures the high build quality and a longlasting product. Based on an advanced DC-to-DC circuit the power supply is capable of delivering a perfect voltage regulation and very stable power output. The built-in SAC (Smart Airflow Control) design keeps the PSU fan spinning at 400 RPM upto 70% load for a almost inaudible operation. REVOLUTION D.F. is designed for high-performance gaming systems requiring high standards in quality and performance.

POWER SUPPLY ERF650AWT

Smart Airflow Control (SAC) design SAC design keeps PSU fan spinning at almost inaudible 400rpm within 70% system load to provide the optimal silent experience

100% 105°C Japanese electrolytic capacitors Highest component standards for maximum durability and stability

Title: Enermax - REVOLUTION D.F. - 80 PLUS Gold Power Supply
URL: https://www.enermaxeu.com/products/power-supplies/high-end/revolution-d-f/index.html
Published: N/A
Author: N/A
Highlights:
Enermax - REVOLUTION D.F. - 80 PLUS Gold Power Supply

 

 

 

 

 

REVOLUTION D.F. is a full modular 80 PLUS® Gold certified PSU series with the patented DFR™ (Dust Free Rotation) technology, preventing dust accumulation and granting a cleaner and long-lasting PSU. The D.F. Switch design offers an on button activation of the DFR™ mode at any time. The choice to use only 100% Japanese 105°C electrolytic capacitors ensures the high build quality and a longlasting product. Based on an advanced DC-to-DC circuit the power supply is capable of delivering a perfect voltage regulation and very stable power output. The built-in SAC (Smart Airflow Control) design keeps the PSU fan spinning at 400 RPM up to 70% load for an almost inaudible operation. REVOLUTION D.F. is designed for high-performance gaming systems requiring high standards in quality and performance.

Nicolas11x12 [EN] Video Review 

Nicolas11x12 [DE] Video Review 

 650W | ERF650AWT | Fully Modular 

 750W | ERF750EWT | Fully Modular 

 850W | ERF850EWT | Fully Modular 

 850W | ERF850EWT | Fully Modular 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

## Efficiency 

The 80PLUS® Gold-certified power supply achieves up to 92% efficiency at 230VAC between 20 and 100% load. This not only results in low heat generation but also reduces its own CO2 footprint.

REVOLUTION D.F. helps systems to meet the EU eco-design directive 2013 ErP Lot 6 and 2014 ErP Lot 3 (< 0.5W in standby mode*) due to a high-efficient 5V standby (+5Vsb) circuitry. Moreover, it supports EU regulation no. 617/2013 demanding amongst others 85% efficiency at 50% load and 82% at 20% and 100% load.

* only in combination with an ErP ready mainboard

 

## Power 

The DC-to-DC design generates the secondary voltages (+5V and +3.3V) from the primary voltage rail (+12V). The positive effect is higher efficiency, clean output voltages (low ripple noise) and perfect voltage regulation at all loads.

At least four 6+2P (8P) PCI-E connectors ensure power for multi-GPU systems (MGPU & SLI™) and overclocked processors.

A multi-rail design with four 12V rails distributes the power with maximum stability and safety.

...

## Cooling 

The integrated 13.9cm Enermax fan with patented Twister Bearing™ technology ensures an efficient and continuously silent cooling and long lifetime with up to 160,000 hours MTBF.

The patented technology DFR™ (Dust Free Rotation) reduces the dust accumulation on the fan blades. After starting the PSU, the fan spins in reverse at full speed for a few seconds removing dust. Afterwards, it returns to normal operation.

...

## Compatibility 

Intel® ATX12V v2.4, compliant with the Intel Power Supply Design Guide for Desktop Platform Form Factors Revision 1.31 April 2013.

Full support of the C6/C7 energy-saving functions of Intel® processors, first introduced with the Haswell™ generation.

Worldwide compatibility with automatic 100-240VAC input and up to 0.99 with active Power Factor Correction (PFC).

 

## Quality & Safety 

5 Years Manufacturer Warranty.

Enermax only uses high-quality components including first-class Japanese 105°C electrolytic capacitors for maximum stability and durability.

Enermax SafeGuard, multiple protection circuit that keeps the power supply and the system safe from damage by short circuit (SCP), over voltage (OVP), under voltage (UVP), over current (OCP), over temperature (OTP), over power (OPP) as well as surges and inrush current (SIP).

Non-Stop 24/7 industrial class performance. Full rated power output at 50°C ambient temperature.
